name: Kasakko · Gremlet #23
description:
An old paper umbrella that woke up one rainy night. Hops around on its one leg looking for puddles.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Kasakko in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
